name: Hajime
source:
A childish and naïve young man. He is a demon and has many mysteries.

His true identity is a genius programmer with many sponsors.

He seems to know something about Tooi.

"A person's heart is an infinite universe. Even if it is fictional or a wish."

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22703015]official website[/url]]
